One tall indoor ficus-like tree: two slender woody trunks rising clearly above the pot, with three airy clusters of broad rounded dark olive leaves concentrated in the upper half. Exposed trunk provides visible height. Heavy squat round warm-gray matte ceramic floor planter. Must read as a taller room plant through exposed trunks and elevated foliage, not merely an enlarged short plant or elongated pot. Preserve established high overhead cutaway camera: see leaf upper surfaces, elliptical pot opening and soil, compressed visible pot front; retain vertical height without switching to a frontal botanical illustration. Broad simplified painted leaf shapes, restrained mottled paint, sparse main veins, natural muted greens. Neutral generic materials suitable for any room in futuristic underwater base. Modest matte finish, no bright metallic outlines, no glossy reflections, no photographic microtexture. Keep all leaf tips, trunks and entire planter inside generous transparent margins. One isolated complete plant, true transparent background and gaps. No furniture, floor, external cast shadow, glow, labels or other objects.
